marks.gloss_en: if shen, whose object is not to damage, is liable, then keren, whose object is to damage, all the more so
keren would be exempt on the model of a slave or maidservant, who intend damage yet their master is exempt
the mishna's 'ox' means its foot, and mav'eh its tooth (Rava, for Shmuel)
the slave/maidservant exemption has its own weighty reason -- lest a provoked slave burn a neighbour's stack and obligate his master 100 maneh a day -- so it models nothing about keren
